summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. New files: rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py (one parametrized test covering valid and invalid shapes, plus a check that SHACLPathError is not a ValueError). The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass: 40 passed under the shared venv. ruff and black are not installed in that venv, so formatting was checked only by confirming no line exceeds 88 characters. Nothing was committed and no other files were changed.
